def metric(value, format="{:g}"):
    """Return number with SI unit prefix."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        num = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return value
    if num == 0:
        return "0"
    sign = "-" if num < 0 else ""
    num = abs(num)
    prefixes = ["", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E", "Z", "Y"]
    exp = int(math.floor(math.log10(num) / 3))
    exp = min(exp, len(prefixes)-1)
    scaled = num / (10**(exp*3))
    # Format with up to 3 significant digits
    formatted = f"{scaled:.3g}"
    # Remove trailing .0 if integer
    if '.' in formatted:
        formatted = formatted.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
    return f"{sign}{formatted}{prefixes[exp]}"
